sections.title: Mental model
sections.body:
Modern CSS = **Flexbox** for 1D, **Grid** for 2D, **Container Queries** for 2026.

- **Flexbox** — distribute space along one axis.
- **Grid** — `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(...))` for responsive.
- **Container queries** — components respond to *their own* size, not viewport.
- **Custom properties (CSS vars)** — runtime-mutable; design tokens.
- **`:has()`** parent selector — landed in all modern browsers.

sections.title: Likely interview hooks
sections.body:
- **`gap`** works in flex now — no more margin hacks.
- **CSS layers** (`@layer`) — explicit cascade ordering, no specificity wars.
- **Container queries** > media queries for component-driven design.
- **Logical properties** — `margin-inline-start` for i18n-friendly RTL.
- **Subgrid** — child grids inherit parent tracks.

sections.title: Speaking template
sections.body: > *"I'd lay this out with CSS Grid for the page, Flexbox inside cards, container queries for components that need to respond to their own width, custom properties for tokens, and `@layer` to keep the cascade predictable."*
